output_list.reason: The mintToken function allows an attacker to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens, which can lead to an integer overflow if the total supply exceeds the maximum value that can be stored in a uint256 variable.

The buy function calculates the amount of tokens to be bought based on the msg.value divided by the buyPrice. If the msg.value is too large, it can cause an integer overflow, leading to an incorrect calculation of the amount of tokens to be bought.

The sell function calculates the amount of tokens to be sold based on the amount parameter multiplied by the sellPrice. If the amount parameter is too large, it can cause an integer overflow, leading to an incorrect calculation of the amount of tokens to be sold.
